t: Ram is 20 years older than Rahul. ‘n’ years ago Ram was thrice as old as Rahul. ‘2n’ years from now the ratio of the ages of Ram and Rahul will be 15 : 11. What is the value of ‘n’?
e: Ram is 20 years older than Rahul. ‘n’ yrs ago -> Ram : Rahul = 3 : 1 => 3x - x = 20 => 2x = 20 => x = 10. Ram was 30, Rahul was 10. Present -> Ram = 30+n, Rahul = 10+n. After 2n years -> Ram = 30+3n, Rahul = 10+3n. (30+3n)/(10+3n) = 15/11 => 330 + 33n = 150 + 45n => 12n = 180 => n = 15.
h: राम, राहुल से 20 वर्ष बड़ा है। ‘n’ वर्ष पहले राम की आयु राहुल से तीन गुनी थी। अब से ‘2n’ वर्ष बाद राम और राहुल की आयु का अनुपात 15 : 11 होगा। ‘n’ का मान क्या है?

t: If the father's age 12 years ago was four times the age of his son and 10 years hence son's age will be a year less than half of the father's age, then find the ratio of their present ages.
e:
Let the present age of the son be 'a' years.
Age of the father 12 years ago = Age of the son 12 years ago * 4
=> Age of the father 12 years ago = (a - 12) * 4
Age of father 10 years hence = (Age of Son 10 years hence + 1) * 2
According to question,
(a -12) * 4 + 12 + 10 = (a + 10 + 1) * 2
=> 4a - 48 + 22 = 2a + 22
=> 2a = 48
=> a = 24
Father's present age = (24 - 12) * 4 + 12 = 60
Hence, the required ratio = 60/24 = 5: 2
h: यदि 12 वर्ष पहले पिता की आयु उसके पुत्र की आयु की चार गुनी थी और 10 वर्ष बाद पुत्र की आयु पिता की आयु के आधे से एक वर्ष कम होगी, तो उनकी वर्तमान आयु का अनुपात ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: In a family, the combined age of husband, wife and a son is 90 years. The husband is the oldest. The difference in the ages of the husband and wife is the age of their son. After 10 years, the age of the son would be half the age of his father. What is the present age of his mother [in years]?
e: Let age of husband, wife and son = H, W, S H + W + S = 90 W = 90 – H – S -------- {i} H – W = S W = H – S -------- {ii} From {i} & {ii} eqn ---- 90 - H - S = H – S 270 = 6H + 2S -------- {iii} → From question – [H + 10] = 2[S+10] H + 10 = 2S + 20 2S = H – 10 ------- {iv} From eqn {iii} & {iv} 270 = 6H + H – 10 7H = 280 H = 40 2S = 270 – 6 × 40 S = 15 yr. W = 40 – ×15 = 35 yrs
h: एक परिवार में पति, पत्नी और बेटे की संयुक्त आयु 90 वर्ष है। पति सबसे बड़ा है। पति और पत्नी की आयु में अंतर उनके बेटे की आयु का है। 10 वर्ष बाद, बेटे की आयु उसके पिता की आयु की आधी होगी। उसकी माँ की वर्तमान आयु [वर्षों में] क्या है?
eh: पति, पत्नी और बेटे की आयु = H, W, S H + W + S = 90 W = 90 – H – S -------- {i} H – W = S W = H - S -------- {ii} {i} और {ii} समीकरण से ---- 90 - H - S = H - S 270 = 6H + 2S -------- {iii} → प्रश्न से – [H + 10] = 2[S+10] H + 10 = 2S + 20 2S = H – 10 ------- {iv} समीकरण {iii} और {iv} से 270 = 6H + H – 10 7H = 280 H = 40 2S = 270 – 6 × 40 S = 15 वर्ष. W= 40 - ×15 = 35 वर्ष

t: The present ages of a mother and her son are in the ratio of 6 : 1. When the son becomes as old as his mother now, then the ratio of his father’s age to his mother’s age is 13 : 11. When the son becomes as old as his father now, then the sum of the ages of the father and son will be 115 years. The present age of the father is?
e: M : S = 6x : x. When son becomes mother’s age = S -> x + 5x = 6x. M -> 6x + 5x = 11x. At this time F : M = 13 : 11. F’s age = 13x. Now, when son’s age is father’s current age. Father’s current age = 13x - 5x = 8x. A.T.Q., S = x + 7x = 8x, F = 8x + 7x = 15x. F + S = 8x + 15x = 115 => 23x = 115 => x = 5. Father’s current age = 8x = 8 * 5 = 40 years.
h: एक माँ और उसके बेटे की वर्तमान आयु 6 : 1 के अनुपात में है। जब बेटा अपनी माँ की वर्तमान उम्र का हो जाता है, तो उसके पिता की आयु का उसकी माँ की आयु से अनुपात 13 : 11 होगा। जब बेटा अपने पिता की वर्तमान उम्र का हो जाता है, तो पिता और बेटे की आयु का योग 115 वर्ष होगा। पिता की वर्तमान आयु कितनी है?
eh:
स्मार्ट ट्रिक: S=x, M=6x. +5x साल बाद: S=6x, M=11x. इस समय F=13x.
अतः वर्तमान में F = 13x - 5x = 8x.
जब बेटा F(8x) की उम्र का हो (यानी +7x साल बाद): F = 8x+7x=15x, S = 8x.
15x+8x = 23x = 115 ⟹ x=5. वर्तमान F = 8 × 5 = 40 years (a)
बेसिक तरीका: Time-travel कॉन्सेप्ट से x निकालें।

t: A father said to his son, "n years back I was as old as you are now. My present age is four times your age n years back." If the sum of present ages of the father and the son is 130 years, what is the difference of their ages?
e: F n = S—{i} F = 4[S n]—{ii} F + S =130—{iii} From {i} & {ii} S + n = 4S - 4n 3S = 5n = let S = 5x & n = 3x From {ii} & {iii] F + S=130 S + n + S =130 2S + n =130 →2 × 5x + 3x =130 13x =130 X =10 Now son’s age = 5x =50 Father age F + 50=130 F = 80 Difference = 80 - 50 = 30yrs.
h: एक पिता ने अपने बेटे से कहा, "n वर्ष पहले मैं तुम्हारी वर्तमान आयु के बराबर था। मेरी वर्तमान आयु n वर्ष पहले की तुम्हारी आयु की चार गुनी है।" यदि पिता और पुत्र की वर्तमान आयु का योग 130 वर्ष है, तो उनकी आयु में क्या अंतर है?
eh: F –n = S—{i} F = 4[S –n]—{ii} F + S =130—{iii} {i} और {ii} से S + n = 4S -4n 3S = 5n = मान लीजिए S = 5x और n = 3x {ii} और {iii] से F + S=130 S + n + S =130 2S + n =130 →2 × 5x + 3x =130 13x =130 X =10 अब बेटे की उम्र = 5x =50 पिता की उम्र F + 50=130 F = 80 अंतर = 80 -50 = 30 वर्ष।

t: Ten years from now, a person's age will be the square of what it was ten years ago. Find the person's current age.
e:
Let, current age = x years Then, x + 10 = (x - 10)²
=> (x - 10)² - x - 10 = 0
=> x² - 21x + 90 = 0
=> x = 15 or 6
[x = 6 is discarded as 10 years ago, the person's age would be -4 years which is impossible.]
So, x = 15
h: दस साल बाद, किसी व्यक्ति की आयु दस साल पहले की आयु का वर्ग होगी। उस व्यक्ति की वर्तमान आयु ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: Anshika is two years younger than Bhawna and seven years older than Rekha. If the sum of present age of Rekha and Bhawna is 25 years, then find the age of Anshika after three years.

Present age of Anshika = 'n' years
Present age of Bhawna = 'n + 2' years
Present age of Rekha = 'n - 7' years
Now,
n - 7 + n + 2 = 25
n = 15
Age of Anshika after three years = 15 + 3 = 18 years

t: Four years ago, A was three times as old as B. Six years from now, A will be twice as old as B. Find their current ages.
e:
Let current ages of A and B are A years and B years.
Now,
A - 4 = 3(B - 4)
=> A = 3B - 8
Also,
A + 6 = 2 (B + 6)
=> A = 2B + 6
So,
3B - 8 = 2B + 6
=> B = 14
A's present age = 34 years

t: The sum of the ages of Arun and Bharti is 24 years such that Arun is older. If the age of Arun and Bharti is doubled, the difference is 8 years. What is the age of Arun, in years?

t: P got married 15 years ago. Today her age is 1(3/5) times her age at the time of her marriage. At present her son's age is 1/5 of her age. What was her son's age 4 years ago as a fraction of P's age at that time?
e:
P's current age = p
Age at marriage = p - 15
p = (8/5) X (p - 15)
p = (8/5)p - 24
(3/5)p = 24
p = 40 years
Son's current age = (1/5) X 40 = 8 years
4 years ago: Son = 8 - 4 = 4, P = 40 - 4 = 36
Fraction = 4 / 36 = 1/9
Option 1 is the correct answer
h: P की शादी 15 साल पहले हुई थी। आज उसकी उम्र उसकी शादी के समय की उम्र से 1(3/5) गुना है। वर्तमान में उसके बेटे की उम्र उसकी उम्र की 1/5 है। 4 साल पहले उसके बेटे की उम्र P की उस समय की उम्र के अंश के रूप में क्या थी?

t: The present age of Tanya is 3/8 times of Meenu's age. Four years ago, Tanya's age was 2/7 times Meenu's age at that time. What was the age of Jiya six years ago if Jiya is four years younger than Meenu?
e:
Let present age of Tanya = 3x years and present age of Meenu = 8x years
Four years ago, Tanya's age was 2/7 times Meenu's age at that time.
=> (3x - 4)/ (8x - 4) = 2/7
=> x = 4
So, the age of Jiya 6 years ago = 8 * 4 - 4 - 6 = 22 years
h: तान्या की वर्तमान आयु मीनू की आयु की 3/8 गुना है। चार साल पहले, तान्या की आयु उस समय मीनू की आयु की 2/7 गुना थी। यदि जिया मीनू से चार साल छोटी है, तो छह साल पहले जिया की आयु क्या थी?

t: Ratio of present age of A to B is 3:5 and after 6 years the ratio becomes 21:31. Find the age of B before 3 years.
e:
Let the present age of A and B be 3x years and 5x years respectively.
According to question,
(3x + 6)/(5x + 6) = 21/31
93x + 186 = 105x + 126
x = 5
Present age of B = 5 * 5 = 25 years
Age of B before 3 years = 25 - 3 = 22 years
h: A की वर्तमान आयु का B से अनुपात 3:5 है और 6 वर्ष बाद यह अनुपात 21:31 हो जाता है। 3 वर्ष पहले B की आयु ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: After two years, Pallavi's age was 3 times of Firoz's age. The ratio between Firoz's age 4 years hence and Pallavi's age 5 years hence, will be 4: 11 respectively. If Bhim is 6 years older than Firoz, then what was Bhim's age five years ago?
e:
Let present age of Pallavi and Firoz are (3x - 2) years and (x - 2) years, respectively.
(x - 2 + 4)/(3x - 2 + 5) = 4/11
=> x = 10
Hence, Bhim's age five years ago = (10 - 2 + 6 - 5) = 9 years
h: दो साल बाद, पल्लवी की उम्र फिरोज की उम्र से तीन गुना थी। 4 साल बाद फिरोज की उम्र और 5 साल बाद पल्लवी की उम्र के बीच का अनुपात क्रमशः 4:11 होगा। यदि भीम फिरोज से 6 साल बड़ा है, तो पांच साल पहले भीम की उम्र क्या थी?

t: The present age of Reeta is twice the age of Ravi five years hence. After three years, the ratio of the age of Reeta and Ravi is 3:1 respectively. What is the present age of Reeta?
e:
Let the present age of Reeta = '2y' years
Present age of Ravi = 'y - 5' years
According to question,
(2y + 3)/(y - 5 + 3) = 3/1
2y + 3 = 3y - 6
y = 9
Present age of Reeta = 2*9 = 18 years
h: रीता की वर्तमान आयु पाँच वर्ष बाद रवि की आयु से दोगुनी है। तीन वर्ष बाद, रीता और रवि की आयु का अनुपात क्रमशः 3:1 है। रीता की वर्तमान आयु क्या है?

t: Meenu is 38 years old. Her daughter is 8 years old. In how many years will Meenu be double her daughter's age?
e:
Let the time after which Meenu will be double of her daughter's age = 'x' years
According to the question:
(38 + x) = 2 * (8 + x)
38 + x = 16 + 2x
x = 22 years

t: If the square of two times a boy's present age is decreased by sixteen times the present age of a boy, is equal to 240 more than the square of the present age of the boy, then the present age of the boy is:
e:
Let the present age of the boy be 'X' years
According to question,
(2X)<sup>2</sup> - 16 * X = 240 + X<sup>2</sup>
3X<sup>2</sup> - 16X - 240 = 0
3X<sup>2</sup> - 36X + 20X - 240 = 0
3X (X - 12) + 20 (X - 12) = 0
(3X + 20) (X - 12) = 0
X = 12 [X ≠ -20/3]
h: यदि किसी लड़के की वर्तमान आयु के दो गुने के वर्ग में से लड़के की वर्तमान आयु के सोलह गुने को घटा दिया जाए, जो लड़के की वर्तमान आयु के वर्ग से 240 अधिक हो, तो लड़के की वर्तमान आयु क्या है?
